name: Customer redeems a referral reward and sees purchase history

planSteps.description: Navigate to the local Brash3D home page through the TestSprite local tunnel.
Verify the booking form includes the optional Referral code field.

Choose an available appointment slot, then enter exactly this disposable fixture data in every required field: Full name 'TestSprite Referral Customer', Email 'testsprite-referral-fixture@local.test', WhatsApp '+15550001111', City 'Bogota'. Leave the optional Referral code blank. Confirm City is non-empty before submission.
Submit the booking. This existing fixture customer has one eligible referral reward, so do not complete Stripe Checkout and do not enter any payment details.
Verify the app navigates to the secure customer session page, shows the booking payment as 'Referral reward', and does not redirect to Stripe Checkout.

Verify the customer page shows Purchase history containing 'TestSprite historical purchase' and displays the invite code 'BR3D-TESTSPRITE-FIXTURE'. Verify it no longer says a free booking is ready, because the one fixture reward was redeemed.
